message.content: {"mechanism_id":"success-magnitude-gated-memory","target_component":"SHADE memory update (M_F, M_CR) and archive insertion","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-06","trace_path":"diagnostic_trace_F10_s11_s55","function":"F10","seed":11,"metric":"late_success_rate_vs_best_raw","observed_value":0.617},"causal_hypothesis":"On ill-conditioned F10, tiny fitness deltas are counted as successes, so memory and archive fill with low-information parents, diluting F/CR learning and stalling best_raw.","algorithmic_change":"Weight memory updates and archive insertions by a normalized improvement magnitude g = (parent_fit - trial_fit)/(|parent_fit|+eps), not by raw |delta_f| or binary success.","mathematical_rule":"g_i = max(0, (f_parent - f_trial) / (|f_parent| + 1e-12)); w_i = g_i / (sum_j g_j + 1e-12); M_F = sum(w_i * F_i^2) / sum(w_i * F_i); M_CR = sum(w_i * CR_i); archive insert only if g_i > tau (tau = 1e-6).","expected_effect":"Memory reflects genuinely improving steps, reducing spurious high-success noise and lowering best_raw on F10 while preserving exploration.","failure_prediction":"If tau too high, archive starves and r2 diversity collapses; if too low, no change from baseline.","ablation_plan":"Compare baseline SHADE vs gated-memory with tau in {0, 1e-6, 1e-4} on F10 seeds 11-55; report best_raw and success_rate.","nearest_known_methods":"Weighted Lehmer memory (SHADE), success-history adaptation, quality-residual credit (excluded).","implementation_requirements":"Track parent_fit and trial_fit at selection; compute g; modify M_F/M_CR update and archive push condition; add tau parameter."}
